The '''Repair Module''' is a Defense Mod that periodically repairs a Bot Defender.
==Description==
''The Earth Defense Command's standard-issue module for repairing broken machinery. It periodically repairs your Base Defender.''

==Max Stats==

* 1-Star
** Health: 257
** Attack: 17
** Rating: 41
* 2-Star
** Health: 536
** Attack: 34
** Rating: 103
* 3-Star
** Health: 3,258
** Attack: 206
** Rating: 638
*4-Star
** Health: 7,002
** Attack: 442
** Rating: 1,201 (sig 30)

==Abilities==

=== Basic Abilities ===
*Repair
*Block Proficiency

=== Abilities ===
*Passive:
**Repair x Health over 3 seconds. Recharges in 20 seconds.
**+10-18% Block Proficiency.

==Strategy==

=== Defense ===
The Repair Module is generally useful for any Bot. But, it is recommended to pair this Module with Bots with a high health rating and armor or resistance, like [[Grindor]], [[Ultra Magnus]], or [[Grimlock]].

It can also be used to give an additional Repair boost to Bots with their own healing abilities to prolong battles, such as [[Ratchet]], [[Blaster]], and [[Waspinator]].

But as Bots get stronger, the fixed amount of health are pitifully negligible.

=== Raids ===
* [[Shockwave|Shockwave's]] and [[Cheetor|Cheetor's]] Special Attacks can inflict Repair Block, and as such can prevent the opponent from recovering Health if timed properly.
*[[Grimlock]], [[Megatron (ROTF)]] and the demolitions’ massive damages will cause more health to deplete that the repair module can repair.
*[[Megatronus]] and [[Nemesis Prime]] can steal the health that was repaired by the repair module.
